plan.title: Annual Donation Summary
plan.subtitle: A comprehensive overview of donor contributions and geographic distribution for the current fiscal year

panels.title: Total Amount Collected
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%'

panels.title: Total Number of Transactions
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%'

panels.title: Donations by Payment Mode
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode" AS mode, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly Contribution Trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%m', CAST("Date" AS DATE)) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Donations by City
panels.sql: SELECT "City" AS city, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Top 10 Donors
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor" AS donor_name, SUM("Amount") AS total_donated FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:
This year, our fundraising efforts reached a total of {{p1.total_amount}} across {{p2.transaction_count}} individual transactions. This represents a significant milestone for our organization's sustainability.

Our most active regions include several key cities, contributing to the overall momentum seen in our monthly trends. The distribution of funds shows a steady flow of support throughout the year, peaking during specific seasonal windows.

We are particularly grateful to our top contributors, listed in the detailed breakdown, whose generosity drives our mission forward.
